# Castor (AI-First Scaffold)

Castor is a Node.js/TypeScript + React + RBAC scaffold optimized for AI-driven feature delivery.
Product managers provide only natural-language intent. Agents perform end-to-end implementation.
It is a pnpm monorepo: Fastify 5 + Zod + Drizzle backend on PostgreSQL, React 19 frontend with shadcn/ui + Tailwind CSS v4 + motion, and an MCP server exposing the toolchain.

## Backend Structure (apps/api)

- App bootstrap: `apps/api/src/app.ts` (entry `apps/api/src/main.ts`, scheduler worker `apps/api/src/worker.ts`)
- Global route assembler: `apps/api/src/router.ts`
- Table definitions (model layer, Drizzle): `apps/api/src/db/schema/` (register in `apps/api/src/db/schema/index.ts`)
- Domain modules: `apps/api/src/modules/admin/`, `apps/api/src/modules/component-center/`
- Per-module layers: `schema.ts` (Zod), `repository.ts`, `service.ts`, `routes.ts`; per-domain `router.ts`
- Database migrations: `apps/api/drizzle/` (drizzle-kit generate, journal in `apps/api/drizzle/meta/_journal.json`)
- Engineering scripts: `apps/api/scripts/`
- Shared capabilities: `apps/api/src/common/`
- Permission helper: `apps/api/src/common/auth.ts` (`hasMenuPermission` as default API permission check)

## Tech Stack

- Backend: Node 22 + TypeScript + Fastify 5 + Zod + Drizzle ORM + PostgreSQL (pg)
- Frontend: React 19 + Vite + React Router + Axios (TypeScript / TSX)
- UI: shadcn/ui (new-york, Radix) + Tailwind CSS v4 + motion + lucide-react; react-hook-form, @tanstack/react-table, sonner
- Import/Export: csv-parse / exceljs (csv and xlsx only; .xls is not supported)
- Monorepo: pnpm workspaces (`apps/api`, `apps/web`, `apps/mcp`)

## MCP Docs Rule

- If MCP docs/skills are available for the task domain, read them first, then implement.
- For UI components, read the shadcn/ui docs or registry first (shadcn MCP if available) plus the `shadcn-ui-skills` skill; add new primitives with `apps/web/scripts/shadcn-add.sh <component>` (runs `npx shadcn@latest add` through a local REGISTRY_URL relay, because the CLI cannot reach ui.shadcn.com directly here).
- Keep final implementation aligned with existing project patterns (repo code wins over upstream docs).

## Frontend Structure (apps/web)

- Dynamic routes: `apps/web/src/App.tsx`
- App shell (sidebar, top bar, ⌘K, theme): `apps/web/src/components/app/`
- shadcn/ui primitives: `apps/web/src/components/ui/` (config `apps/web/components.json`)
- Design tokens (light/dark) and brand gradient utilities: `apps/web/src/index.css`
- Module pages: `apps/web/src/modules/**/pages/**/index.tsx` (reference CRUD page: `apps/web/src/modules/admin/pages/users/index.tsx`)
- Page pattern reference implementations (standard / card / tree / stats list, detail, step form, dynamic form, kanban, gantt, advanced table): `apps/web/src/modules/component_center/pages/patterns/`, all on one shared demo API (`apps/api/src/modules/component-center/demo-record`, `/api/admin/component-center/demo-records`); which page to copy for a requirement, and the backend pieces it needs: AGENTS.md "Page patterns (which page to copy)"; overview: [Component gallery → Building a feature from a pattern](https://robeshell.github.io/castorjs/guide/components#from-a-pattern)
- Module APIs: `apps/web/src/modules/**/api/*.ts` (types generated from the OpenAPI doc: `apps/web/src/shared/api/openapi.d.ts`)
- Shared business components (PageHeader, DataTable, Filters, FormDialog, FormFields, ConfirmAction, StatusBadge, ConditionBuilder, …): `apps/web/src/shared/components/`
- Shared component usage reference (live examples, each example's exact source, key props; look here before using a shared component): the gallery's Components section, `apps/web/src/modules/component_center/pages/components/<group>_page/` (examples in `examples/*.tsx`, props in `props.ts`); overview: [Component gallery → Components](https://robeshell.github.io/castorjs/guide/components#components)
- Shared import/export UI: `apps/web/src/shared/components/data-transfer/` (ImportDialog / ExportDialog)
- Shared API client/utilities: `apps/web/src/shared/api/request.ts`, `apps/web/src/shared/utils/file.ts`, `apps/web/src/lib/` (toast, format, motion, chart-theme)
- Pages use only `@/components/ui/*`, `@/shared/components/*`, lucide-react and Tailwind semantic color classes; no other UI component library (antd, MUI, etc.) and no hard-coded hex colors

## Definition of Done

Any new module/feature should include:

1. Backend table definition + module (schema/repository/service/routes) and registration (usually via `pnpm scaffold`).
2. Frontend page + API client + menu routing.
3. RBAC menu/button permissions in `apps/api/scripts/seed-rbac.ts`.
4. Run `pnpm seed:rbac -- --incremental` to sync menus and refresh super-admin permissions.
5. Drizzle migration generated (`pnpm db:generate --name <desc>`), applied (`pnpm db:migrate`), and proven with `psql -d <db> -c '\d <table>'`.
6. OpenAPI JSON update (`pnpm openapi:generate`) and optional Apifox push (`pnpm openapi:apifox`).
7. Feature gate: `pnpm verify -- --module <name>` all green.
8. If import/export is implemented: follow the existing pattern (`apps/api/src/common/tabular.ts` + `ImportDialog` / `ExportDialog` from `apps/web/src/shared/components/data-transfer/`).
9. Report "migrated to <tag>" (migration tag) when schema changed, and tell the user to run `pnpm db:migrate` in other environments.
10. Every delivery must include a concise "next steps" command checklist for the user.
